description: Build a FILTER formula that shows the rows of a range matching 1-3 conditions (equals, contains, starts/ends with, one of, blank, number and date comparisons), optionally sorted and with a "no match" message. Returns the formula and a note.

cells_are_text.description: Numbers/dates are stored as text: wrap in VALUE / DATEVALUE

column.description: Column letter to test, e.g. C

value.description: Value to compare (not needed for blank / notblank). Dates as 2026-03-31, numbers with a dot.

no_match_message.description: If set, wrap in IFERROR and show this text when no row matches

order.description: Sort the result by its first column

range.description: Rows to show, first and last column: A2:D, A2:D500, A:D or Data!A2:D

separator.description: Argument separator: "," (US/UK locale) or ";" (many European locales)

name: sheets_filter_formula
title: Google Sheets FILTER formula
